mapper.select: select id, activity_id, goods_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, paid_stock, create_time, update_time from group_buy_stock where activity_id = #{activityId} limit 1

select id, activity_id, goods_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, paid_stock, create_time, update_time from group_buy_stock where activity_id = #{activityId} and goods_id = #{goodsId} limit 1 for update
select id, activity_id, goods_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, paid_stock, create_time, update_time from group_buy_stock order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_stock_flow ( flow_id, activity_id, goods_id, team_id, order_id, flow_type, quantity, before_available_stock, after_available_stock, remark, create_time ) values ( #{flowId}, #{activityId}, #{goodsId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{flowType}, #{quantity}, #{beforeAvailableStock}, #{afterAvailableStock}, #{remark}, #{createTime} )
